key_points.evidence_quote: reliable Sony Ericsson, a phoneless spell, then day-one Motorola Droid
key_points.point_text: First phone Sony Ericsson J100 was reliable, then a phoneless spell, then a day-one Motorola Droid that became central.
key_points.reasoning: All three beats captured with the centerpiece detail intact.

key_points.evidence_quote: attention traps made a consumer of him, so he retreated to dial-pad
key_points.point_text: Droid captivation curdled into disillusionment over notifications and attention traps, ending in a switch to a dial-pad phone.
key_points.reasoning: Honeymoon, consumer-feeling cause, and dial-pad consequence all captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: Screens, keyboards, styluses, and watches all failed the same way
key_points.point_text: Return experiments with screens, keyboards, styluses, and watches failed identically: unneeded features, ads, ecosystem lock-in.
key_points.reasoning: All four tried categories and the three-part verdict captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: Wanted week-long battery, waterproofing, SD slot, jack, decent mic
key_points.point_text: Requirements: long battery, ruggedness, SD plus jack, decent mic/speaker, customization; rejects: best camera, AI enhancements, cloud/offline dependence.
key_points.reasoning: Want/reject lists captured, but the battery qualifier is upgraded from long to week-long (week belongs to one Ulefone model), so a Must-have qualifier is narrowed.

key_points.evidence_quote: Apple and Google deliberately limit offline use to push cloud services
key_points.point_text: Apple and Google deliberately limit offline options (SD removal, minimal storage) to push cloud, blocking mountain-offline use.
key_points.reasoning: Attribution, mechanism, and motive captured; mountain use-case context is supporting color.

key_points.evidence_quote: Ulefone rugged phones solved real problems at a tenth of flagship prices
key_points.point_text: Ulefone rugged phones solve real problems at ~1/10 flagship price: durable, dual SIM/SD/jack, one model a week per charge, surviving drops, swimming, and a deep lake dive.
key_points.reasoning: Price ratio, feature set, abuse survival, and lake caveat all captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: Phones are tools, not status symbols; big brands serve profit, small ones serve needs
key_points.point_text: Thesis: phones are tools not status symbols; Apple/Google/Samsung serve profit ecosystems while small firms fill the gap.
key_points.reasoning: Thesis and big-vs-small contrast captured exactly.

key_points.evidence_quote: He paid nothing, declined extra charges, and returned to the market
key_points.point_text: Black Friday Pixel deal sparked lock-in and cost anxiety; unpaid order collapsed over extra charges and he returned to the market.
key_points.reasoning: Deal, anxiety motive, non-payment, declined extras, and market return captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: O1 model names were correct though its specs were generally wrong ... assumed faulty in places
key_points.point_text: LLM pipeline: O1 names candidates (right names, wrong specs), gsmarena scrape code builds a comparison table, Claude cleaning code is unverified and assumed partly erroneous.
key_points.reasoning: All three stages plus the wrong-specs/right-names and assumed-errors caveats captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: Only Fairphone 4 and Moto G Power met 5G plus eSIM plus SD ... Edge 40 ... no SD card slot ... read_html with proxies is next
key_points.point_text: Filter yields only Fairphone 4 and Moto G Power (weak cameras, big screens, 2021-old Fairphone); Edge 40 lacks SD; next step is read_html with proxies.
key_points.reasoning: Filter result, caveats with 2021 date, Edge 40 explanation, and next step all captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: TCL overheated on calls and its screen stayed unreadable in direct light ... water-repellent G85 is the compromise
key_points.point_text: TCL 50 XE trial failed (heat, unreadable screen, restricted paper/ink modes) and was returned; IP68 G75 unavailable so water-repellent G85 is next.
key_points.reasoning: Heat, screen, mode restrictions, return, G75 absence, and G85 compromise all captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: get_phone_specs scrapes gsmarena links into a pandas DataFrame and CSV
key_points.point_text: Scraper implementation details and the 18-URL list with a duplicated Narzo entry as process color.
key_points.reasoning: Mechanism captured at the outline's granularity; URL-level minutiae are Nice context and the outline cites the function faithfully.

key_points.evidence_quote: take my phone to the mountains, listen to music, read, and take notes
key_points.point_text: Motivating offline use-case: mountains with music, reading, and notes without connectivity worry.
key_points.reasoning: Offline-hostility motive is captured but the concrete mountains-music-reading-notes vignette itself is not stated in the loglog.
